messages:
maya: Heads-up: after today's IdP cert rotation some SP assertions are failing downstream and SCIM showed sporadic re-provisions. Rolling into eng-sre now.
owen: Seeing `audience mismatch` in RBAC lookup for a subset of sessions. Example from auth-proxy:
```
2026-06-05T11:42:12Z auth-proxy WARN assertion accepted but audience lookup failed: issuer='https://idp.eu.partner/app/ABCD' mapping_key='https://idp.partner.com/app/abcd'
```
lucy: SCIM tried to reconcile fallback svc account and then scim-provisioner hit KMS unwrap errors. KMS logs show context shape mismatch: envelopes written with context {"region":"eu","tenant":"redwood"} but current unwrap expects {"tenant":"redwood"}.
kms-bot: KMS: 6 DecryptDenied events for key alias "prod/rekey-2026" in 11:42-11:45 window (DecryptDenied: ContextMismatch).
maya: Immediate steps: 1) add compatibility mapping for issuer host normalization (strip region subdomain) in idp-connector, 2) enable short-lived legacy KMS unwrap path for infra-admin only, 3) run rewrap job to re-encrypt envelopes with the canonical context, 4) run SCIM backfill with `--no-deprovision` and confirm.
owen: I'll patch idp-connector to normalize host (drop `.eu.`) and roll to 3% canary. idp-bot: canary deploy started -> 3% traffic.
lucy: I'll prepare a rewrap tool: read envelope, attempt unwrap via legacy path, encrypt with new context, atomic swap; add dry-run + limit flags. Will run dry-run on shard-2 first.
maya: Also capture audit logs for 11:30-12:00 and push to sec-audit. Open vuln-triage to assess if KMS context variance could allow misuse; initial audit shows only DecryptDenied, no successful legacy unwraps by non-privileged actors.
owen: Rolling mapping reduced audience mismatch errors from 5.2% -> 0.9% in canary.
lucy: Rewrap dry-run (limit=200) completed: 196 rewrapable, 4 flagged for manual review. Scheduling gradual rewrap window and will coordinate with infra to keep TTL short.
maya: Action items assigned: owen -> idp mapping canary; lucy -> rewrap + scim backfill `--no-deprovision`; maya -> incident + audit export + vuln ticket. ETA 4h for full mitigation.
idp-bot: note: idp metadata cached for 5m; recommend clearing cache post-config to avoid split behavior.
maya: Good catch. Clear caches after canary. Keep updates here and incident channel for postmortem notes. :thumbsup:
